name: JAC Japan map scale 20 km, TAKEDA human, start mapping

steps.code: local w,h=Map.GetGridSize(); if w~=154 or h~=67 then error('map grid mismatch '..w..'x'..h) end; local minors=0; local freeCities=0; for _,m in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMinors()) do if PlayerConfigurations[m:GetID()]:GetCivilizationTypeName()=='CIVILIZATION_FREE_CITIES' then freeCities=freeCities+m:GetCities():GetCount() else minors=minors+1 end end; if minors~=0 then error('city-states present: '..minors) end; if freeCities~=0 then error('Free Cities own '..freeCities..' cities') end; local localPlayer=Game.GetLocalPlayer(); if localPlayer<0 then error('no local player') end; if PlayerConfigurations[localPlayer]:GetLeaderTypeName()~='LEADER_JAC_TAKEDA_NOBUTORA' then error('local leader mismatch') end; if #PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()~=22 then error('major count') end; local expected={{90,31,2},{111,32,4},{109,30,2},{97,23,3},{101,28,5},{97,27,2},{102,35,1},{94,24,3},{90,29,1},{91,37,1},{86,34,12},{78,35,4},{87,33,2},{84,34,1},{69,47,3},{80,46,1},{75,45,1},{73,36,1},{65,43,1},{56,40,3},{24,30,2},{135,47,1}}; local civs={'CIVILIZATION_JAC_ODA','CIVILIZATION_JAC_DATE','CIVILIZATION_JAC_ASHINA','CIVILIZATION_JAC_HOJO','CIVILIZATION_JAC_YAMANOUCHI_UESUGI','CIVILIZATION_JAC_TAKEDA','CIVILIZATION_JAC_NAGAO','CIVILIZATION_JAC_IMAGAWA','CIVILIZATION_JAC_MATSUDAIRA','CIVILIZATION_JAC_ASAKURA','CIVILIZATION_JAC_ASHIKAGA','CIVILIZATION_JAC_MIYOSHI','CIVILIZATION_JAC_ROKKAKU','CIVILIZATION_JAC_HONGANJI','CIVILIZATION_JAC_OUCHI','CIVILIZATION_JAC_AMAGO','CIVILIZATION_JAC_MORI','CIVILIZATION_JAC_CHOSOKABE','CIVILIZATION_JAC_OTOMO','CIVILIZATION_JAC_SHIMAZU','CIVILIZATION_JAC_RYUKYU','CIVILIZATION_JAC_AINU'}; local mapIdForLeader={}; for mapId=0,21 do mapIdForLeader[leaders[mapId+1]]=mapId end; local gameSlotForMapId={}; for i=0,21 do local source=mapIdForLeader[PlayerConfigurations[i]:GetLeaderTypeName()]; if source==nil or gameSlotForMapId[source]~=nil then error('leader to map player mapping '..i) end; gameSlotForMapId[source]=i end; local cityOwners={[4864]=0,[5039]=1,[4729]=2,[3639]=3,[4413]=4,[4255]=5,[5492]=6,[3790]=7,[4556]=8,[5789]=9,[5322]=10,[5468]=11,[5169]=12,[5320]=13,[7307]=14,[7164]=15,[7005]=16,[5617]=17,[6687]=18,[6216]=19,[4644]=20,[7373]=21,[4732]=1,[4579]=1,[4576]=2,[5041]=1,[3643]=3,[3951]=4,[4721]=4,[3953]=3,[3182]=4,[3803]=4,[4717]=5,[3942]=7,[4709]=0,[4249]=7,[4706]=10,[6103]=10,[5175]=10,[5785]=10,[5794]=10,[5477]=10,[5017]=12,[5774]=11,[5782]=11,[5012]=10,[5934]=10,[5927]=11,[6385]=10,[7313]=14,[7309]=14,[6086]=10,[6546]=10,[6214]=19,[5756]=19,[4646]=20}; local seenCities={}; local garrisons={}; for i=0,21 do for _,unit in Players[i]:GetUnits():Members() do local info=GameInfo.Units[unit:GetUnitType()]; if (info.Combat or 0)>0 or (info.RangedCombat or 0)>0 or (info.Bombard or 0)>0 then garrisons[i..':'..(unit:GetY()*w+unit:GetX())]=true end end end; local palaceType=GameInfo.Buildings['BUILDING_PALACE'].Index; local totalCities=0; for i=0,21 do local p=Players[i]; if not p or not p:IsAlive() then error('missing player '..i) end; local source=mapIdForLeader[PlayerConfigurations[i]:GetLeaderTypeName()]; if PlayerConfigurations[i]:GetCivilizationTypeName()~=civs[source+1] then error('faction mismatch '..i) end; local e=expected[source+1]; if p:GetCities():GetCount()~=e[3] then error('city count '..i..'='..p:GetCities():GetCount()..' expected '..e[3]) end; totalCities=totalCities+p:GetCities():GetCount(); local capital=p:GetCities():GetCapitalCity(); for _,city in p:GetCities():Members() do local plot=city:GetY()*w+city:GetX(); local sourceOwner=cityOwners[plot]; if sourceOwner==nil or gameSlotForMapId[sourceOwner]~=i or seenCities[plot] then error('city position/owner mismatch '..plot) end; seenCities[plot]=true; local isCapital=capital and city:GetX()==capital:GetX() and city:GetY()==capital:GetY(); if city:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(palaceType)~=isCapital then error('palace mismatch '..plot) end; if isCapital and not garrisons[i..':'..plot] then error('capital garrison missing '..plot) end end; if not capital or capital:GetX()~=e[1] or capital:GetY()~=e[2] then error('capital mismatch '..i) end end; if totalCities~=56 then error('total city count '..totalCities) end; local land=0; local sourceOwners=''; for index=0,w*h-1 do local tile=Map.GetPlotByIndex(index); if tile and not tile:IsWater() then land=land+1; if tile:GetOwner()<0 then error('unowned land plot '..index) end; local encoded=sourceOwners:byte(land); if not encoded then error('extra land plot '..index) end; local source=encoded-65; if tile:GetOwner()~=gameSlotForMapId[source] then error('initial territory owners mismatch '..index) end end end; if land~=1082 then error('land tile count '..land) end; for i=0,21 do local p=Players[i]; if p then for _,unit in p:GetUnits():Members() do if GameInfo.Units[unit:GetUnitType()].UnitType=='UNIT_SETTLER' then error('settler in slot '..i) end end end end; local passage='not checked in faction mapping scenario'; local humanCapital=Players[localPlayer]:GetCities():GetCapitalCity(); local loyalty=humanCapital:GetCulturalIdentity():GetLoyaltyPerTurn(); local minimumLoyaltyPerTurn=1000; for i=0,21 do for _,city in Players[i]:GetCities():Members() do local rate=city:GetCulturalIdentity():GetLoyaltyPerTurn(); if rate<minimumLoyaltyPerTurn then minimumLoyaltyPerTurn=rate end; if rate<0 then error('negative initial city loyalty/turn '..i..':'..city:GetID()..'='..rate) end end end; if JAC_JAPAN_LOYALTY_WATCH and JAC_JAPAN_LOYALTY_WATCH.handler then Events.CulturalIdentityCityConverted.Remove(JAC_JAPAN_LOYALTY_WATCH.handler) end; JAC_JAPAN_LOYALTY_WATCH={majorDefections={}}; JAC_JAPAN_LOYALTY_WATCH.handler=function(playerID, cityID, fromPlayer) local former=fromPlayer and Players[fromPlayer]; if former and former:IsMajor() then local lost=tostring(fromPlayer)..'->'..tostring(playerID)..':'..tostring(cityID); table.insert(JAC_JAPAN_LOYALTY_WATCH.majorDefections,lost) end end; Events.CulturalIdentityCityConverted.Add(JAC_JAPAN_LOYALTY_WATCH.handler); return '22 majors, 0 city-states, 56 cities/capitals, all land owned, no settlers;
